hero.title: Helping children and youth thrive in school, in life and in faith
hero.intro: Kingdom Love Springs exists to give children and youth from poor and vulnerable communities across Kenya the opportunity to thrive in school, in life, and in faith.

hero.title: Keeping children safe
hero.intro: Most of the people we serve are children. Protecting them comes first, online and in person.

commitments.title: First names only
commitments.text: Children appear on this website by first name only, or a chosen name. We never publish surnames.

commitments.title: No locations
commitments.text: We never publish a child’s school, village, estate or exact location. We only mention regions, like “Western Kenya”.

commitments.title: Photos with consent
commitments.text: We only share photos when a parent or guardian has given consent. We prefer group photos at tournaments, and we never show children in distress.

commitments.title: Stories told with care
commitments.text: A child’s story is shared only with their guardian’s consent, and the child’s agreement where they are old enough. We focus on growth and hope, never on painful details.

commitments.title: Location data removed
commitments.text: We remove location information from photos before they go online.

commitments.title: Sponsorship is personal
commitments.text: There are no public profiles of individual children. Sponsorship enquiries are handled personally by our team.

commitments.title: Forms ask about you, not children
commitments.text: Our forms never ask for information about children. We only ask adults for what we need to reply.

safeguarding.concernText: If you have any concern about the safety or wellbeing of a child connected with Kingdom Love Springs, please tell us straight away. Every concern is taken seriously and handled in confidence.
safeguarding.concernPending: Our safeguarding contact person will be listed here. Until then, please reach us through the contact page.

hero.title: Your privacy, in plain words
hero.intro: This page explains what happens to your information when you use this website.

sections.title: This website doesn’t store your messages
body: When you fill in a form on this website, nothing is saved on the website. Your answers are turned into a message that opens in your own WhatsApp or email app, and you decide whether to send it.
Once you send it, your message reaches Kingdom Love Springs like any other WhatsApp message or email.

sections.title: What we use your information for
body: We use the details you send us only to reply to you and to follow up on your enquiry, for example about sponsoring a child, volunteering or praying with us.
We never sell or share your information for marketing.

sections.title: Information about children
body: Our forms never ask for information about children. Please don’t include children’s names or personal details in your messages.

sections.title: No tracking
body: This website doesn’t use advertising or analytics cookies, and it doesn’t load tracking scripts. Fonts and images are served from this website itself.
The website is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may keep basic technical logs (such as IP addresses) to keep the service secure.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019, you can ask to see the information we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, and object to how it is used. Contact us and we’ll help.
